notes.title: Oak City Indie Games 2025
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871549/f26afe278e5b737c1f6742bb1c142c2027c4b8f1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Oak City Indie Games[/b] is an annual showcase that highlights the work of North Carolina and other regional indie game developers. [b]Idosra: The Electric Renaissance[/b] will be one of the games highlighted at this event![/p][p]This year's event will be held at Wake Tech's Southern Campus in Raleigh, NC. The showcase will be held October 18, 10am to 9pm.[/p][p]If you are in the area, come out and support us and our fellow regional indie developers! There will be dozens of games to play, and other events to enjoy.[/p][p]Information and tickets can be found on the showcase's eventbrite page. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.eventbrite.com/e/oak-city-indie-games-2025-tickets-1462383451269" style="button"]Click here to visit the page and read more about the showcase![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
